reasons.blasmophet-levia-consumed: Levia's demi-hero transform lets the deck replay a blood debt card from banishment each turn and stops blood debt life loss, which rewards everything the deck already does.
reasons.shadow-of-blasmophet-red: Discarding a 6-power card tutors a blood debt card straight into the banished zone, enabling Levia, Doomsday and Diabolic Offering in one swing.
reasons.consuming-strength-yellow: Pairs with Beckoning Hunger's Blasmophet tokens and adds an instant banish of a blood debt card that also pumps the next attack.
reasons.rumbling-hunger-red: Creates Blasmophet tokens and gains go again once the deck has banished a 6-power card, which its many banish effects set up.
reasons.deep-rooted-evil-yellow: Becomes free card advantage, since it can be replayed from banishment on the turns the deck already banishes a 6-power card.
reasons.tribute-to-the-legions-of-doom-red: Banishes a random card from hand, usually a 6-power card in this deck, which turns on Levia's ability and earns this card +2 power.
reasons.unworldly-bellow-red: A go-again pump that also banishes three graveyard cards, fueling Doomsday, Soul Harvest and Levia's 6-power condition.
reasons.goremass-summoning-blue: A go-again Blasmophet maker that enables Consuming Lash and stacks with the deck's frequent 6-power banishes.
reasons.blasmophets-boon-blue: A blue pitch card that becomes a 6-power banish target once a Blasmophet is out, feeding Levia and the Feasting and Feeding triggers.
reasons.wall-breaker-red: Gains overpower off the deck's consistent 6-power banishes and is itself a blood debt red for the banished zone count.
